enc_low_confidence: Low confidence or undecodable characters. Check the preview and pick the encoding yourself
chapter_none: No chapters found. Building as one section
cover_auto: Plain cover from title and author
preview_empty: Add a file to preview its beginning
msg_replaced: {count} characters could not be decoded and were left as �
msg_still_loading: Files are still being read. Try again in a moment
warn_large_file: {name} is {size} MB. Files over 100 MB can take a long time. Continue?
warn_many_chapters: {name}: {count} chapters. The pattern looks too broad. Continue anyway?
warn_cover_small: The cover image is small ({width} px wide). 600 px or more is recommended. Continuing anyway
err_decode_failed: Cannot read with the chosen encoding: {name}
err_bad_line: Line number must be between 1 and {max}
err_blank_line: A blank line cannot start a chapter
log_no_chapters: {name}: no chapters found, built as one section
cli_desc: Convert text files to EPUB 2. Detects the encoding (EUC-KR, CP949, UTF-8, UTF-16) and splits chapters automatically. Run without inputs to open the GUI.
cli_encoding: Encoding: auto (default), utf-8, cp949, euc-kr, utf-16, shift_jis, gb18030, ...
cli_chapter_pattern: Regex for chapter heading lines (default: 제N장, 제N화, N., N화, Chapter N, 第N章, 第N話)
cli_no_chapters: Do not split chapters; build one section
cli_paragraph: Paragraphs: auto, blank (blank-line separated), line (one per line). Default auto
cli_title: Title (default: file name; applies only to a single input)
cli_text_lang: Text language ko/en/zh/ja, default auto (by script). Written to dc:language
cli_cover: Cover: path to an image, or auto (plain cover from title and author). Default none
cli_indent: Indent the first line of paragraphs (default)
cli_line_height: Line spacing 1.4/1.6/1.8; omit to follow the reader
cli_help: show this help message and exit
cli_need_yes: A confirmation is needed but this is not an interactive terminal. Run again with -y
